verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and both share the same faults. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy, breaking the original reading order. There is a large dead gap between the text block and the Shop Sale button. The button now sits on the decorative circle, which used to back the bottle. A packs its text tightly, with the eyebrow jammed under the body line, and leaves a wide gap (about 95px) between the bottle and the text. B spaces its text more evenly and keeps the bottle closer to the copy, so it groups better. B's bottle does sit closer to the top and bottom edges, which makes it slightly cramped.
